'''Fallanji''' was a green-skinned [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alvorine]] who took over [[Krova (Hutt)|Krova the Hutt's]] information-trading business after the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] fled the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
A minor crime lord on the planet Alvorine, during the first years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Fallanji was a member of Krova the Hutt's organization. After Krova was captured by [[Langro Dis]] and held by the Republic, Fallanji offered the government any information they needed to convict the crime lord, so long as Fallanji himself could take over Krova's small empire.<ref name="THH" />
